test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held on: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the value of sec² 54° - cot² 36° + (3)/(2) sin² 37° × sec² 53° + (2)/(sqrt3) tan 60°?
solution:
Concept used :

tan(90° - θ) = cot θ 

cot (90° - θ) = tan θ 

sec (90° - θ) = cosec θ 

cosec²θ - cot²θ = 1 

sec²θ - tan²θ = 1 

Calculations :

 sec2 54° - cot2 36° + (3)/(2) sin2 37° × sec2 53° + (2)/(sqrt3) tan 60°

⇒ sec2 54° - cot2 (90° - 54°) + (3)/(2) sin2 37° × sec2 (90° - 37°) + (2)/(sqrt3) tan 60°

⇒ sec2 54° - tan2 54° + (3)/(2) sin2 37° × cosec2 37° + (2)/(sqrt3) tan 60°

⇒ 1 + 3/2 + 2 

⇒ 9/2

**The value is 9/2.**
